messages.content: We prefer human-readable code so that others can understand how your program works. In previous competitions, compressed code, bytecode, and large blocks of hardcoded results made some submissions difficult to understand and digest.

messages.content:
Hi there! I'm very excited about this challenge and putting together a small team to participate now. :)

I am curious as to whether later stages of this challenge, or a separate challenge entirely, will measure efficiency of compiled Lean code rather than just reduction in the kernel. I certainly appreciate that this brings the compiler into the TCB, but I also think that Lean has a bright future for building verified and fast code, and that encouraging innovation for this application as well would be wonderful.
